families.name: body
families.prompt: Production modular paper-doll assets for the reference Min pixel character. Match her chibi proportions, warm peach skin, dark brown pixel outlines, cream highlights, soft stepped pixel shading, and black-to-brown hair aesthetic. TRUE crisp pixel art with a consistent low-resolution pixel grid, no smooth vector shapes, no text or labels, genuinely transparent background. Each item isolated, centered in its own equal-width cell, with a transparent gap between cells. No items crossing cell boundaries. Every piece is meant to combine with separately drawn body, face, eyes, hair and clothing. Make exactly THREE cells in one horizontal atlas. Cell 1: ONLY a headless, armless chibi doll body: short neck, modest ivory opaque base camisole and bloomers, two small peach legs and white sneakers, no head, no hair, no arms. The legs and feet point forward. Cell 2: ONLY the detached LEFT chibi arm, relaxed and straight down, rounded tiny hand, peach pixel shading, shoulder at top, wrist at bottom. Cell 3: matching detached RIGHT arm, mirror of left, with identical scale and skin. The torso is narrow and short, legs tiny, as in reference. These are structural underlayers for a large-headed dress-up character; keep them simple and clean.

families.name: clothes
families.prompt: Production modular paper-doll assets matching the reference Min chibi pixel character. Use dark brown crisp pixel outlines, warm cream highlights, soft stepped pixel shading, and a consistent low-resolution pixel grid. Each asset must have the same texture and detail density as her hair, face and cream gingham dress. Transparent background, no text/labels or scenery. Items centered in separate equal-width cells with clear padding and no overlap. These are independent replaceable game layers, never draw a person or body behind them. One horizontal atlas of exactly FOUR independent complete outfits, FRONT VIEW, garment only, NO body, head, hands, legs or shoes. Fit the SAME tiny chibi torso under a large head: narrow fitted bodice, very short waist, gently flared skirt ending above knees, visible fabric folds and pixel highlights. Neckline and shoulder straps should align identically. 1: Cloud, cream gingham sleeveless dress with warm beige checks, fitted waist and airy skirt, like reference. 2: Berry, a fitted soft pink knit cardigan worn over an ivory blouse, with a matching pink pleated skirt and tiny cream collar, not a giant block or box. 3: Ocean, a pale blue sailor dress with a tiny navy bow, white collar, fitted waist and blue flared skirt. 4: Meadow, a sage green fine-knit short cardigan over a cream blouse, with a light cream gently pleated skirt. All include upper clothes AND lower skirt as one garment layer. Charming detailed pixel textures, natural clothing shapes. Their scale, neck openings, waistline and hemline are consistent; preserve negative space for arms at sides.
